people.name: Samson
people.line: Israelite judge with great strength from God

translations.web: He went down and talked with the woman, and she pleased Samson well.
translations.bsb: Then Samson continued on his way down and spoke to the woman, because she was pleasing to his eyes.
translations.kjv: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.
translations.asv: And he went down, and talked with the woman, and she pleased Samson well.
